column1: Hello. I'm Jim Walls, retired California Highway Patrol Officer and designer of the Police Quest series.
column2: 你好。我是 Jim Walls，已退休的加州公路巡邏隊警官，也是警察故事系列的設計者。

column1: With Police Quest, you're not just watching some movie star portraying the glamourous part of police work. As Detective Sonny Bonds, YOU'RE the man behind the badge.
column2: 在警察故事中，你不只是看著某個明星演員表演警察工作光鮮亮麗的一面。作為警探 Sonny Bonds，你才是那個頂著警徽的人。

column1: It's up to you to learn and follow correct police procedure - to make the right decisions in life and death situations.
column2: 你得學會並遵循正確的警務程序——在生死抉擇中做出正確的決定。

column1: In REAL police work, you have to know when to be a hero and when to rely on caution and use the other team players on the force.
column2: 在真實的警務工作中，你必須知道何時要充當英雄，何時該依靠謹慎並利用隊友的力量。

column1: Some of the incidents in Police Quest 3 are based on actual events that occurred during the course of my career. I managed to survive them. Let's see if YOU can do as well under pressure.
column2: 警察故事3 中的一些案件是根據我職業生涯中發生的真實事件改編的。我設法活了下來。讓我們看看在壓力下你能否做得一樣好。

column1: Here's the scene you're about to be walking into...
column2: 這是你即將走進的場景……

column1: Lytton, once a quiet and peaceful little town, has been growing like a weed. There's new industry, good jobs, and a decent standard of living.
column2: Lytton 曾經是個安靜祥和的小城鎮，現在發展得飛快。有新的產業、好工作和體面的生活水準。

column1: Unfortunately, progress is not without its side effects. Poverty and crime are going up about as fast as the new cultural center.
column2: 不幸的是，進步並非沒有代價。貧困和犯罪率的增長跟新文化中心的發展一樣快。

column1: Homicide Detective Sonny Bonds and his wife Marie are still on a 'honeymoon high' from their wedding a few years back.
column2: 重案警探 Sonny Bonds 和妻子 Marie 還沉浸在幾年前婚禮帶來的「蜜月興奮」中。

column1: Marie's got a good job at Oak Tree Mall and the two have a beautiful new home.
column2: Marie 在 Oak Tree Mall 有份不錯的工作，兩人擁有一幢美麗的新家。

column1: Overburdened as the department is, he's been assigned to Traffic Division for a bit. Seems Traffic's always understaffed.
column2: 儘管警局人手不足，他暫時被分配到交通組。看來交通組總是人手短缺。

column1: Well, that's Sonny's life - and it's a good one, worth protecting. And now it's time for you to assume the role of Detective Sonny Bonds. I happen to know you're in for a heck of a day.
column2: 這就是 Sonny 的生活——是值得保護的美好生活。現在該由你扮演警探 Sonny Bonds 的角色了。我碰巧知道你將面臨不平凡的一天。

column1: Come on. This way.
column2: 來吧。這邊。

column1: Wait for me, Sonny.
column2: 等等我，Sonny。

column1: I'll catch up with you. Got to run to my car.

column1: Don't you think you should checkin at Homicide first?

column1: Sooo... what are we booking this fine upstanding citizen on anyway?
column2: 那麼……我們到底要以什麼罪名起訴這位高尚的公民呢？

column1: Quit clowning around Bonds. Give me a real code.

column1: You sure about that Bonds? Better dust off that Officer's Manual and bone up on your codes.
